jobs.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create a corrected premium exercise illustration, detailed grayscale anatomical rendering with red primary muscle regions, white background and soft contact shadows. No text, numbers or arrows. Use the supplied image only for adult model identity and detailed illustration style. Two equally sized side-by-side panels of barbell bench press from a consistent near-side view slightly elevated and oblique enough to see both hands. Male wears complete opaque black training T-shirt and mid-thigh shorts. Left arms extended bar over chest. Right lower bar to lower sternum, clearly well below head/neck, wrists above elbows, forearms vertical, elbows moderately tucked. Bench supports head/shoulders and buttocks, feet flat on floor. Same rack and barbell, same plates and grip width. Red pectoral-location overlay on intact shirt. Keep complete barbell and both feet visible, no bar intersecting face.
